entry.name: Machine Learning Specialization
entry.note: Andrew Ng's rebuilt classic; the most common starting point in the field

reading.format: Online three-course program with video lessons, code walkthroughs, optional math videos, practice quizzes, and graded assignments.
reading.summary: The Machine Learning Specialization is a three-course online program created by DeepLearning.AI and Stanford Online, taught by Andrew Ng. It is a rebuilt and expanded version of the original machine learning course, covering supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks, and reinforcement learning. Finishing the program indicates the ability to build effective learning algorithms and apply them to real applications.
reading.audience: It is for beginners breaking into AI, and does not require prior math knowledge or a rigorous coding background.
reading.prerequisites: No prior math knowledge or rigorous coding background is required.
